new_episode_events: Kaze spends his last three personal silver on sheep meat, onions and bread. Billy actually swallows the parcel, preserves it in the kitchen and continues exterior travel. No body switch or free food supply.

Chris prepares supper and grants Frylock the trimmings, not good cuts. Frylock, challenged by Shake, constructs a physical offal/wood/string/cloth figure with living Meatwad concealed inside. Meatwad supplies eyes, voice and movement. A deceptive personhood experiment, NOT actual new life, cloning, necromancy, new Frylock power or another Meatwad.

Chris treats the apparent person as potentially alive in light of his actual prior anomalies, then identifies string, misplaced attention and missing Meatwad. He reaches for the knot with a kitchen knife. Meatwad independently bursts out, scattering trimmings before any cutting. No actual surgery or new bodily injury.

Shake claims control/work rights; Meatwad refuses. Charles stages a funeral for the nonliving puppet and drops it into actual surrounding acid. One ordinary kitchen spoon is left there, not Billy's historical souvenir. No sentient death, prisoner movement, formal warden appointment or cult power.

Frylock defends the experiment but nods to Chris's explicit disclosure condition on further supply use and cleans the table. Chris keeps untainted meal portions separate. Meatwad chooses to help with bread rather than play another death; Shake attempts portion control and is refused.

Exterior group stops at stream. K.K. washes blood downstream of Mana, retains arm bandage, offers shade and tends his pear. Using modest physically established roots and his uninjured hand, he opens a planting hollow. Dana steadies the pear while K.K. transplants it above the wet bank and waters it. His own roots withdraw; no instant fruit, plant consciousness or new tree person. Empty tub and plain stick retained.

Chris reports the false creation through banjo audio. Billy agrees to actual mouth egress of the covered meal pot and bread. Chris remains full-size inside; outsiders receive only real reports and meal conversation, not private household omniscience.

Dutch spends four of E34's fifty-nine silver on cloth/ordinary show supplies. An existing HQ crate and a wooden frame conceal Tracy while still-conjoined adult Brian pretends to be a severed head. No actual detachment, surgery, extra body, new technology or repeated Clifford Vader reveal.

Coon advertises and claims direction. Jimmy refuses a knowingly false medical announcement but performs his own material; Timmy independently takes the entrance. Nine silver collected. Tracy participates expecting his own name, then exposes the arrangement and breaks the light frame when spectators treat him as a bonus exhibit.

After a spectator demands refund and blocks Tracy, Dutch deliberately draws his revolver and demands that man's purse instead of refunding. Clifford stands with actual supports and draws his own gun. Neither fires. Audience not retroactively villains; robbery avoidable and chosen.

Timmy opens the front door despite Coon's instruction; Jimmy lets people escape. Cartman claims heroic credit, snags his cape and falls before rising. No major injury assigned. Dutch loses room control and orders rear departure. No automatic cooperation, new powers or invulnerability.

TPP takes the same ledger, tracked money and Clifford's wheelchair/helmet/cape through the rear and leaves via local streets. Dutch counts eighteen silver in the stolen purse. 59 - 4 + 9 + 18 = 82 tracked silver, older treasury separate. Local shout identifies their house. No lease cancellation, new safehouse, police arrival or global report instantiated.
